inferences_to_test: Knowledge that gives a visibly useful additional action may communicate mastery better than skipping unread choices.
Explicit forecast evidence could reduce guessing, while evidence must be earned to preserve discovery.
Dense mobile layout may hide progress and costs; ask people to explain their next action without hints.
limitations: Agent elapsed time is not human reading time. Source-informed path cannot establish discoverability, fun, accessibility, replay demand, retention or willingness to pay.
